verdict.rationale: Docs show a customizable timeline (docs-4/38/49) that feeds into AI-drafted postmortems with inline review suggestions and redrafting (docs-6), plus follow-up tracking and org-wide postmortem completion tracking via list views and policies (docs-5, docs-7/39/68/80). However, there is no explicit documentation of a postmortem template system or a distinct 'publication' step for postmortems (publishing evidence only covers status pages, not postmortem docs). missing for 10: explicit postmortem template library/selection, explicit publication/sign-off workflow for postmortem documents, independent corroboration of the AI drafting quality.
